lines.zh: 我踩着树枝走，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I walk the branches, joints cracking.

lines.zh: 我从高处跳到另一根枝上。
lines.en: I leap from one high branch to another.
I swing across on my arms, fast.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛上跳着细小的电弧。
lines.en: Small arcs jump along my fur.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地走过林冠。
lines.en: I walk the canopy, step by step.
My steps shake leaves loose.

lines.zh: 我绕过树上的巢，没有踩。
lines.en: I go around a nest without stepping on it.
My tail sweeps a leaf.

lines.zh: 我跳下来，落地时蹲了一下。
lines.en: I drop and crouch on landing.

lines.zh: 我带着几只在林间穿行。
lines.en: I move through the trees with several others.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸带着雷的味道。
lines.en: My breath smells of thunder.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边看着下面。
lines.en: I walk while watching below.
I flip over from the branch tip.
All my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 我蹲在树枝上，尾巴垂着。
lines.en: I crouch on a branch, tail hanging.

lines.zh: 风暴丛林里，我们三到七只。
lines.en: In the storm jungle we come three to seven.

lines.zh: 电从我的肩膀上爬过去。
lines.en: Current crawls over my shoulder.
I count the footsteps below.
I crouch on the branch, waiting for rain.
I'm waiting for the rain.

lines.zh: 我抓了抓胸口，发出低响。
lines.en: I scratch my chest and rumble.
The branch bends, but I'm steady.

lines.zh: 雷电缠着我的手，风暴丛林归我。
lines.en: Lightning wraps my hands; the storm jungle is mine.
My eyes shine in the dark.
The wind pushes my fur aside.
I'm judging how far the thunder is.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩起来，像块石。
lines.en: I draw myself in like a stone.
I've held this canopy a long while.
My breathing makes the leaves tremble.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕在枝上稳住。
lines.en: I wrap my tail round the branch to steady.
You're below me, looking up.
I hang upside down and look at you.
You don't belong in these woods.
You've seen my teeth.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西会导电吗。
lines.en: Will that thing in your hand conduct?
I bare my teeth slowly.

lines.zh: 这片风暴林里，雷电归我说了算。
lines.en: In this storm jungle, the lightning answers to me.

lines.zh: 我皮毛上跳着细小的电弧。
lines.en: Small arcs of lightning jump on my fur.
Arcs dance on my shoulders.
Coming up? I'll wait.
I bare my teeth and lightning jumps between them.
Your outline is fixed in my mind.
The lightning backs me up in the jungle.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，估量你的高度。
lines.en: I tilt my head and gauge your height.
I fall back a step and grab a branch.
A patch of my fur is singed.
I growl from deep in my throat.

lines.zh: 电弧散开，我又抓紧树枝。
lines.en: The arc scatters, and I grip the branch again.
My shoulder twitches.
I slide half a foot down the branch.
My sparks jump wildly.

lines.zh: 雷在我指间跳，别靠太近。
lines.en: Lightning jumps between my fingers; keep back.
You hit harder than I did.
I can still lunge once more.
That thing in your hand hums.
That glow draws me near.
I come down the branch slowly.
That noise is worth a look.
I reach out and clench my hand.
Stand still and I'll come down.
It smells like iron.
I crouch on a low branch and watch.
I swing a bit nearer.

lines.zh: 风暴丛林的雷电，绕着我。
lines.en: Storm jungle lightning circles me.
You hit the trunk, and I'm right there.
I drop from above and hit you.
My arm shoves you off.
I swing away and swing back.
We collide and a spark jumps.
You step on a fallen branch.

lines.zh: 我退到树后，很快就藏好了。
lines.en: I slip behind the tree and I'm hidden.
That didn't even shift me.
You hit my chest. Hard.
I press to you, my fur crackling.
Another leaps over from the canopy.

lines.zh: 我们的手碰了一下，有火花。
lines.en: Our hands meet, and sparks jump.
Its fur is greyer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起蹲在同一根枝上。
lines.en: We crouch on the same branch.
It presses its brow to mine.
Sparks jump back and forth between us.
We cry out together.
In this tree we have company.
West is its, east is mine.
The rain comes, and we crowd together.
I come down to pick it up.
This one gives me a shock.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰间的毛里。
lines.en: I stuff it into the fur at my waist.
I bite once and can't break it.
It fell by the roots; I took it.
This will do as a weapon.
I took this. It's mine.
I carry it up high.
It's heavy. Good.
I throw it away. Don't care for it.
You've come in.
The branch I grip is firm.
My fur has all risen.
My teeth grind audibly.
You can't back out of these woods.

lines.zh: 这里是我说了算的地方。
lines.en: This is where I decide things.
Current starts to run down my back.

lines.zh: 你的气味我刻在鼻子里。
lines.en: Your smell is carved into my nose.
You first, or me?
I call, and the others come.

lines.zh: 这棵树杈正好落在我爪下。
lines.en: That fork of the tree sits right under my claws.
My feet have found their grip.
I follow you through the trees.
I swing from branch to branch.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我在另一边。
lines.en: When you look up, I'm on the other side.

lines.zh: 这片林冠每条路我都熟。
lines.en: I know every path in this canopy.
I'm waiting for you to reach open ground.
Leaves keep falling. That's me.
I pick up a broken branch.

lines.zh: 我在枝头蹲低，尾巴绷直。
lines.en: I crouch low on the branch, tail rigid.
You've come under the tree.
I crouch low to leap.
I can see where you'll retreat.
Sparks jump on my hand.

lines.zh: 这棵树的每根枝都是我的。
lines.en: Every branch of this tree is mine.
I slam down from the tree.
That fist came with a charge.
I press you into the leaf litter.
You retreat into the trunk.
I grab your shoulder and haul down.
That numbed your hand.
I swing up and kick.
You crash into the brush.
I land back on a branch and watch.
You can rise. Rare.
A clatter comes from the canopy.

lines.zh: 我们几只一起从树上下来。
lines.en: Several of us come down from the trees.

lines.zh: 我落在一根低枝上，蹲住。
lines.en: I land on a low branch and crouch.
The air now smells of a storm.

lines.zh: 林冠一响，我抓着藤荡下来。
lines.en: The canopy rustles as I swing down on a vine.
I shake my fur and leaves fall.

lines.zh: 我站在枝头，比你高很多。
lines.en: I stand on a branch, far above you.
I patrol this stretch of canopy.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，林子里都动了。
lines.en: I cry out, and the woods stir.
I crack my knuckles.
I come down from the treetop, branch by branch.
My claw marks stay on the bark.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音在林子回荡。
lines.en: My landing echoes through the woods.

lines.zh: 我在最高的枝上蹲住了。
lines.en: I settle on the highest branch.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的毛，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Fire scorches my fur. It stinks.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，蹲了很久起不来。
lines.en: I fall from height and crouch long, unable to rise.

lines.zh: 水让我使不上力，我挣着。
lines.en: Water saps my strength and I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从树上掀了下去。
lines.en: The blast knocks me out of the tree.
An arrow pins my upper arm.

lines.zh: 法术把我身上的电抽干了。
lines.en: That spell drains the charge from me.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃东西，力气不够。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in a while; my strength is short.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身都在叫。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body sings.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从枝上扯下去。
lines.en: The void tears me off the branch.
